title: GCP Operations Suite Overview

insight: Observability is key to maintaining reliable cloud infrastructure.

title: Cloud Logging Overview
content: Cloud Logging is a fully managed service that allows you to store, search, analyze, monitor, and alert on log data and events from GCP and other sources.
insight: Logging is your first line of defense when troubleshooting issues.

title: Log Sinks and Exports
content: Log sinks allow you to export your logs to Cloud Storage, BigQuery, or Pub/Sub for long-term storage or advanced analysis.
insight: Exporting logs to BigQuery is great for compliance and security audits.

title: Creating a Log Sink
content: You create a sink by specifying a name, a destination, and an optional filter to select which logs to export.
insight: Use filters to only export the logs you need, reducing storage and processing costs.

lab.output: Created [my-bq-sink].

title: Log-based Metrics
content: Log-based metrics allow you to create numerical metrics from your log data. You can then use these metrics in Cloud Monitoring charts and alerts.
insight: Great for tracking events that aren't captured by standard system metrics (e.g., specific application errors).

NAME                DESCRIPTION                      FILTER
error_count_metric  Counts log entries with ERROR... severity=ERROR

title: Cloud Monitoring Overview
content: Cloud Monitoring provides dashboards, charts, and alerts to help you understand the performance and health of your services and infrastructure.
insight: Monitoring focuses on 'metrics' (numbers over time), while Logging focuses on 'events' (text messages).

title: Monitoring Dashboards
content: Dashboards allow you to visualize your metrics using various types of charts, such as line charts, heatmaps, and stacked area charts.
insight: Use the predefined dashboards for GCP services to quickly get started.

title: Uptime Checks
content: Uptime checks verify that your web servers and applications are reachable from locations around the world.
insight: Checks can be configured for HTTP, HTTPS, or TCP protocols.

title: Alerting Policies
content: Alerting policies define the conditions under which you should be notified of a potential issue. You can set thresholds on metrics or uptime checks.
insight: Combine multiple conditions into a single policy to reduce alert noise.

title: Notification Channels
content: Notification channels define how you want to be alerted (e.g., Email, SMS, Slack, PagerDuty, or Pub/Sub).
insight: Use different channels for different severity levels (e.g., Slack for warnings, PagerDuty for critical).

title: Cloud Trace Overview
content: Cloud Trace is a distributed tracing system that collects latency data from your applications and displays it in the Google Cloud Console.
insight: Essential for identifying bottlenecks in microservices architectures.

lab.output: View traces in Monitoring -> Trace

title: Cloud Profiler Overview
content: Cloud Profiler is a statistical, low-overhead profiler that continuously gathers CPU usage and memory-allocation information from your applications.
insight: Helps you identify performance regressions and optimize your code's resource consumption.

lab.output: Access via Monitoring -> Profiler

title: Error Reporting Overview
content: Error Reporting counts, analyzes, and aggregates the errors in your running cloud services. It notifies you when new errors are detected.
insight: Automatically groups similar errors, so you don't get flooded with individual alerts.

lab.command: echo 'View errors in Monitoring -> Error Reporting'
lab.output: View errors in Monitoring -> Error Reporting

title: Google Cloud Ops Agent
content: The Ops Agent is the primary agent for collecting telemetry from your Compute Engine instances. It combines logging and monitoring into a single process.
insight: Install the Ops Agent on all your VMs for detailed system-level metrics and logs.

lab.command: echo 'Run installation script on VM instances'
lab.output: Run installation script on VM instances

title: Managed Service for Prometheus
content: GCP provides a fully managed, multi-cloud monitoring service for Prometheus metrics, commonly used in Kubernetes environments.
insight: Allows you to use familiar Prometheus queries and tools while Google manages the backend infrastructure.

lab.command: echo 'Enable Managed Prometheus on GKE clusters'
lab.output: Enable Managed Prometheus on GKE clusters

title: Log Retention Policies
content: You can configure how long logs are kept in Cloud Logging buckets. The default retention is 30 days for the _Default bucket.
insight: Increase retention for compliance or decrease it to save storage costs.

title: Log Views
content: Log views allow you to control which logs a user can see within a bucket. You can grant access to a view rather than the entire bucket.
insight: Great for implementing fine-grained access control for logs (e.g., give a team access only to their app's logs).

title: Log Analytics
content: Log Analytics allows you to use SQL to query your logs stored in log buckets. It's powered by BigQuery under the hood.
insight: Enables complex analysis of logs without needing to export them to a separate BigQuery dataset.

lab.command: echo 'Enable Log Analytics on a log bucket'
lab.output: Enable Log Analytics on a log bucket

title: Cloud Audit Logs
content: Cloud Audit Logs record 'who did what, where, and when' within your Google Cloud projects. There are three types: Admin Activity, Data Access, and System Event.
insight: Admin Activity logs are enabled by default and are free; Data Access logs must be explicitly enabled and can incur costs.

title: Service Level Objectives (SLOs)
content: Monitoring allows you to define and track Service Level Indicators (SLIs) and Service Level Objectives (SLOs) for your applications.
insight: SLOs help you balance the need for feature velocity with the need for service reliability.

lab.output: Configure SLOs in Monitoring -> Services

title: Error Budgets
content: An error budget is the amount of unreliability your service can tolerate before you must stop feature work and focus on stability. It's derived from your SLO.
insight: If you exceed your error budget, it's a signal that your service is too unstable for new changes.

lab.command: echo 'Monitor error budgets in the SLO dashboard'
lab.output: Monitor error budgets in the SLO dashboard

title: Cloud Debugger Snapshots
content: Cloud Debugger (now integrated into other tools) allows you to inspect the state of a running application at any code location without stopping or slowing it down.
insight: Use snapshots to capture the value of variables and the call stack at a specific point in time.

lab.output: Access via Monitoring -> Debugger (Legacy)

title: Network Intelligence Center
content: Network Intelligence Center provides a suite of tools for monitoring, verifying, and optimizing your GCP network.
insight: Tools include Connectivity Tests, Performance Dashboard, and Firewall Insights.

lab.output: Access via Networking -> Network Intelligence Center
